Supreme Court Rules Arrests Invalid Without Written Reason

The Supreme Court of India has ruled that an arrest is invalid if the arrested person is not informed of the written grounds for their detention. The court stated that an accused person, released due to a violation of constitutional safeguards under Article 22, cannot be re-arrested by the same investigating agency without prior court approval. This decision clarifies rules regarding re-arrests.
